concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-006 (compute ΔR² between composition‑only and structure‑aware models on a shared test set) has no corresponding task. The only tasks addressing structure‑aware graphs (T011) are marked as code‑path stubs and do not produce the required ΔR² comparison, leaving the spec requirement unmet.

Success Criterion SC-002 (measure and report the performance gap ΔR² between composition‑only and structure‑aware models) is not covered by any task. Without a task that executes the structure‑aware baseline and computes ΔR², this criterion cannot be satisfied.
